item.title: 🔴 Live: France will ban 'illegitimate' protests in coming days, says Macron
Dalai Lama appointed by China 'is going to be a fake one', exiled former Tibetan leader says
item.description: In an interview with FRANCE 24, exiled former Tibetan leader Lobsang Sangay said any successor to the Dalai Lama appointed by China "is going to be a fake one". He also likened Beijing's ethnic unity law to "an ethnic erasure", said Tibetan concerns had been "downgraded a bit" in US-China talks and accused China of failing to warn of the deadly August floods on the Nepal-Tibet border.

item.title: 🔴 International Criminal Court wins EU's Sakharov human rights prize
International Criminal Court wins EU's Sakharov human rights prize
item.description: The International Criminal Court, which US President Donald Trump's administration has threatened to dismantle "brick by brick", has been awarded the European Union's Sakharov human rights prize.

item.title: Meta's Zuckerberg pitches AI successes to investors with 26% rise in quarterly revenue
item.description: Meta Platforms CEO Mark Zuckerberg touted the company's progress on artificial intelligence during an earnings call on Wednesday and called for more investment. The tech giant's Muse AI agent has garnered 10 million users since its launch six weeks ago, while third-quarter revenue rose to $64.6 billion. Meanwhile, the company is accused of political interference in Brazil's presidential election. Also in this edition, we check in on France's rising borrowing costs.
